comparisons.peer_topic: Consumer Real Estate TDR Modifications in 2022
comparisons.peer_summary: The bank discloses tables presenting the unpaid principal balance, carrying value, and interest rates for consumer real estate loans modified in Troubled Debt Restructurings (TDRs) during 2022, including those initially classified as TDRs and those previously classified as TDRs modified again.
comparisons.comparison: Both JPMorgan and Bank of America disclose financial data tables specifically for residential real estate loans modified in Troubled Debt Restructurings (TDRs). JPMorgan's table focuses on the financial effects of concessions and defaults, explicitly excluding temporary trial modifications. Bank of America’s table presents unpaid principal balance, carrying value, and interest rates for consumer real estate loans modified in TDRs during 2022, including loans initially classified as TDRs and those re-modified. While both cover TDR modifications in real estate, they present different financial metrics (concession effects vs. balances/rates) and reference different reporting periods (JPM presenting a period overview vs. BAC specifically highlighting 2022 data in this context).

sentences.text: The following table provides information about the financial effects of the various concessions granted in modifications of residential real estate loans and about defaults of certain loans modified in TDRs for the period presented.
The following table presents only the financial effects of permanent modifications and does not include temporary concessions offered through trial modifications.

The following table presents the December 31, 2022 unpaid principal balance, carrying value, and average pre- and post-modification interest rates of consumer real estate loans that were modified in TDRs during 2022.

The following Consumer Real Estate portfolio segment tables include loans that were initially classified as TDRs during the period and also loans that had previously been classified as TDRs and were modified again during the period.
